content.thinking:
Fix that typo: an ipv4-looking host is a valid DNS name (numeric labels allowed) → it should be accepted as a claim only if in the directory; `sip:ember@192.168.1.1` is not a directory alias → identity reject. Let me set expect to {"status":"reject","reason":"identity"}.

Also I should double check "host 254" case: ("a."*127) = 254 chars → labels a×127, total before trailing dot... `a.a.a...a` with 127 labels: length = 127*1 + 126 dots = 253 → that's valid (253). Hmm, ("a."*127) ends with a dot → the string is 254 chars with a trailing dot → before trailing dot = 253 → valid! So that case should be accepted (well, identity reject since not in directory). Let me use a longer one for the invalid: ("a."*128) → 256 chars, before trailing dot 255 > 253 → syntax. Let me adjust both cases.

'''C("ipv4 host", j(raw="MESSAGE sip:i@r.t SIP/2.0\\r\\nFrom: <sip:ember@192.168.1.1>\\r\\nTo: <sip:i@r.t>\\r\\nCall-ID: c\\r\\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\\r\\nContent-Length: 0\\r\\n\\r\\n"), {"status":"reject","reason":"identity"})''')
